prompt:
Create one clean 2×2 pixel-art sprite atlas for a Daggerfall Unity talking portrait. Use the single supplied image as the exact local reference grid: it shows the selected guarded/skeptical face and the four intended poses. Preserve the face identity, warm muted palette, pixel-cluster texture, exact crop and framing, hair, brow shapes, and the narrow guarded eye openings.

Cell order, with no labels or gutters: top-left LEFT gaze, eyes open; top-right RIGHT gaze, eyes open; bottom-left LEFT gaze, eyes half-closed; bottom-right RIGHT gaze, eyes half-closed. Each cell represents the complete upper portrait crop at 64×35 aspect ratio, aligned identically to the reference.

Only move the gaze horizontally. Both eyes must track the same canvas direction together while preserving natural source convergence. Keep the irises compact and dark olive-brown/amber, with dark shaded sclera and only tiny warm source-like glints. Do not enlarge the iris or eye aperture; no broad cream or white bands, no bright flashes, no round/vector-like iris. Maintain continuous lids and the selected asymmetric guarded brows unchanged. In both lower cells, the upper lids must visibly occlude part of each iris, preserving the same half-closed aperture as the reference rather than widening the eyes.

Keep pixel-art native-looking stepped clusters and soft muted shading. No text, labels, border, gutters, extra eyes, or additional panels. Transparent background false; retain the complete illustrated crop in all four panels.
